🎸 Live Music in Destin FL 2026

Complete Concert & Venue Guide — Every Show, Every Stage

Everclear. Stephen Marley. Smash Mouth. Free Eagles tributes on the waterfront. Nightly Irish sessions. And LuLu's & AJ's running seven days a week. This is the one guide you need.

Updated March 2026  ·  By Destin Condo Getaways  ·  8 min read

Destin doesn't just have beaches. It has Everclear. Stephen Marley. Smash Mouth. Free Eagles tributes on the waterfront. Irish pub sessions every single night. And a local scene at LuLu's and AJ's that runs seven days a week from spring through summer. This is your complete guide to live music in Destin, Florida in 2026.

Whether you're planning a vacation and want to know what's on during your stay, or you're a music lover looking for the best nights out on the Emerald Coast — we've pulled together every venue, every big show, and every free concert happening in Destin in 2026, in one place.

Quick answer: The biggest live music months in Destin are April and May, when Club LA hosts major acts like Everclear, Stephen Marley and Atreyu — and the legendary Concerts in the Village series runs every Thursday night at Baytowne Wharf. But there's live music every single night at AJ's and LuLu's from March through summer.

The Best Live Music Venues in Destin, FL

Destin's live music scene is centered around the Harbor and a handful of iconic spots that between them cover every taste — from rowdy rock shows to free family-friendly concerts under the stars to cozy Irish pub sessions.

LuLu's Destin
Daily · Free
Live local music every single day 5–9pm. Waterfront, family-friendly, rotating artists. The easiest live music night in Destin.
AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar
Daily · Destin Harbor
Multiple stages on the Harbor. Afternoon and late-night sets. House bands, touring acts and the famous late-night upstairs deck.
Club LA
Ticketed · Rock & Reggae
Destin's premier indoor concert venue. Everclear, Stephen Marley, Atreyu, Sebastian Bach — this is where the big names play.
Concerts in the Village
Thu Nights · Apr–Jun
The 30th Annual Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation series. Thursday nights in Sandestin's Baytowne Wharf Village. Ticketed, world-class tribute acts.
Baytowne Wharf Wednesday Nights
Wed Nights · Free
Free tribute band concerts every Wednesday April through June, 7–9pm at the Events Plaza Stage. Bring a lawn chair.
McGuire's Irish Pub
Nightly · Irish Music
Traditional Irish music nightly from 9pm. Rotating visiting musicians from Ireland. A Destin institution since 1977.

The week of April 23–25 is especially stacked — Everclear and Atreyu at Club LA, Yacht Rock Schooner at Concerts in the Village, and free Baytowne tribute shows Wednesday night. If you can only pick one week to be in Destin for music, that's the one.

Free Concerts in Destin 2026

Not everything costs a ticket. Some of the best live music in Destin is completely free — and the Baytowne Wharf concert series is genuinely world-class for a free outdoor show.

Baytowne Wharf — Free Wednesday Night Concerts (April)

  • Apr 1 — The M-80s: Explosive 80s Rock
  • Apr 8 — Departure: The #1 Journey Tribute Band
  • Apr 15 — 7 Bridges: "Best Eagles Tribute on Earth" (Rolling Stone)
  • Apr 22 — Ron Adams: Shadow of the King (Elvis + Johnny Cash)
  • Apr 29 — Emerald Coast Blues Brothers

All shows start at 7pm on the Events Plaza Stage at the Village of Baytowne Wharf inside Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. Bring a lawn chair or blanket. Drinks and food available from Village restaurants.

LuLu's Destin — Free Nightly Local Music

LuLu's has live local music every single day of the week, 5–9pm, at no charge. The lineup rotates through Gulf Coast artists like Logan Lassiter, The 78's, Meredith Hicks, and Gypsy Pearl — coastal folk, acoustic rock, and singer-songwriter styles. Check the LuLu's Destin music calendar for the current week's lineup.

Nightly Live Music: LuLu's, AJ's & McGuire's

One of the things that makes Destin special is that you don't need a ticket or a plan to find great live music. These three venues run live entertainment every single night through the season.

LuLu's Destin

Founded by Lucy Buffett (Jimmy Buffett's sister), LuLu's at Legendary Marina has built a reputation as one of the most consistently fun live music spots on the Gulf Coast. The formula is simple: rotating local and regional artists, a waterfront deck, cold drinks, and good vibes. Music runs 5–9pm daily. Families welcome.

AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar

AJ's on the Destin Harbor has multiple performance areas — afternoon shows on the main deck (4–8pm) and late-night sets upstairs until 1am. In March, Miles Flatt holds down the late-night slot Thursday through Saturday. On Saturdays, Black Eyed Blonde — AJ's house band — takes the stage. Sunday Funday features Jones & Company. It's the kind of venue where you can arrive for dinner and stay until midnight without ever feeling like you should leave.

McGuire's Irish Pub Destin

McGuire's has been a Destin institution since the 1970s. Their entertainment model is unique on the Gulf Coast: they bring in accomplished Irish and American musicians for month-long residencies, 9pm nightly. In Destin right now it's Cormac McGuinness through late March, followed by Mat Hall from April. If you've never spent a weeknight in an Irish pub with a genuinely talented musician working through traditional and modern folk — add it to the list.

30th Annual Concerts in the Village — Destin 2026

The Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation Concerts in the Village is in its 30th year in 2026 — and the lineup is the best it's ever been. Thursday nights from April through June at the Village of Baytowne Wharf in Sandestin, this series brings in polished tribute acts that consistently outperform expectations.

The full 2026 Concerts in the Village lineup:

  • Apr 9 — Smash Mouth
  • Apr 16 — Black Jacket Symphony: The Music of Van Halen
  • Apr 23 — Yacht Rock Schooner
  • Apr 30 — Rumours ATL (Fleetwood Mac Tribute)
  • May 7 — Brass Transit (Chicago Tribute)
  • May 14 — Turnstile (Billy Joel Tribute)
  • May 21 — Boogie Wonder Band
  • May 28 — The Molly Ringwalds
  • Jun 4 — The Return (Beatles Tribute)
  • Jun 11 — A1A (Jimmy Buffett Tribute)

Tickets available through the Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation website. The venue is an outdoor amphitheater — bring a blanket or low-back chair, and arrive early for parking.

Club LA Destin — 2026 Concert Schedule

Club LA is Destin's indoor rock and alternative venue, and the 2026 calendar is packed with names that will have fans driving in from across the Gulf Coast. The venue holds a few hundred people, which means even big acts feel intimate here.

Confirmed 2026 dates at Club LA Destin:

  • Mar 4 — Congress The Band
  • Mar 7 — Pandoras Box
  • Mar 14 — I See Stars
  • Mar 19 — The Funeral Portrait & The Pretty Wild
  • Mar 20 — Wreking Crue
  • Mar 27 — On The Border (Eagles Tribute)
  • Mar 28 — Van Halen Tribute 84
  • Apr 4 — Sebastian Bach
  • Apr 10 — Guardians Of The Jukebox
  • Apr 17 — Pop Evil (The What Remains Tour) & Sierra Pilot
  • Apr 18 — The Broken Hearts (Tom Petty Tribute)
  • Apr 23 — Everclear
  • Apr 24 — Stephen Marley
  • Apr 25 — Atreyu & American Adrenalin
  • Apr 26 — Sumo Cyco
  • May 14 — Emery & Watashi Wa
  • May 19 — Citizen Soldier & New Medicine
  • Jun 11 — Fortunate Youth & Seranation

Tickets for all Club LA shows are available at rockdestin.com. Shows sell out — especially the April headliners. Book early.

Planning Your Destin Trip Around Live Music

If music is a priority for your Destin vacation, here's how to think about timing:

  • March is great for Club LA rock shows and the nightly scene at AJ's and LuLu's — without summer crowds.
  • April is peak music month. Club LA headline week (Apr 23–25) plus Concerts in the Village every Thursday plus free Baytowne Wharf shows every Wednesday. Stack your nights.
  • May keeps the Concerts in the Village rolling through Memorial Day weekend, with Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac and Chicago tributes.
  • June wraps the series with Beatles and Jimmy Buffett tributes — and LuLu's and AJ's hit their peak summer stride.

Pelican Beach Resort — where our condos are located — puts you minutes from the Destin Harbor (AJ's, LuLu's) and a short drive from Club LA and Baytowne Wharf. You won't need to plan transportation for the Harbor venues — it's walkable from the beach.

Frequently Asked Questions — Live Music Destin FL

Where is the best live music in Destin FL?
For nightly free music, LuLu's Destin and AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar on the Destin Harbor are the top picks — both run live music seven nights a week. For bigger ticketed acts, Club LA hosts national and regional rock and reggae shows. For free outdoor concerts, Baytowne Wharf runs a Wednesday night series every April.
Are there free concerts in Destin in 2026?
Yes — several. LuLu's Destin has free live music every night 5–9pm. Baytowne Wharf runs a free Wednesday night tribute concert series every April (7–9pm). McGuire's Irish Pub nightly music is free with no cover. The Concerts in the Village series at Baytowne Wharf on Thursday nights requires a ticket.
Who is playing at Club LA Destin in 2026?
Major acts at Club LA Destin in 2026 include Everclear (Apr 23), Stephen Marley (Apr 24), Atreyu (Apr 25), Sebastian Bach (Apr 4), Pop Evil (Apr 17), and Fortunate Youth (Jun 11). See the full Club LA calendar at rockdestin.com.
What is Concerts in the Village Destin?
The Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation Concerts in the Village is a long-running outdoor concert series held every Thursday night from April through June at the Village of Baytowne Wharf inside Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. The 2026 series is in its 30th year. Acts include Smash Mouth (Apr 9), Black Jacket Symphony: Van Halen (Apr 16), Rumours ATL — Fleetwood Mac Tribute (Apr 30), and A1A — Jimmy Buffett Tribute (Jun 11).
Does LuLu's Destin have live music every day?
Yes. LuLu's Destin at Legendary Marina features live local music seven days a week, typically 5–9pm. The lineup rotates through Gulf Coast artists and the admission is free. Check the LuLu's Destin music calendar at lulusfunfoodmusic.com for the current week's performers.
What month has the best live music in Destin?
April 2026 is the standout month — Club LA hosts Everclear, Stephen Marley and Atreyu in the same week (Apr 23–25), Concerts in the Village runs every Thursday, and free Baytowne Wharf tribute shows run every Wednesday. It's the most concentrated week of live music on the Emerald Coast.
